titles.secondary: World Cheese Awards as Dairy Producers Target Consumers in Asia
titles.entity_title: World Cheese Awards as Dairy Producers Target Consumers in Asia

synopses.short: World Cheese Awards as Dairy Producers Target Consumers in Asia
synopses.medium: World Cheese Awards as Dairy Producers Target Consumers in Asia
synopses.long:
The World Cheese Awards event, in the English city of Birmingham, has given the dairy industry a chance to highlight its best products amid efforts to expand sales in Asia. We hear from the event and get analysis of challenges facing dairy producers from the winner of the best cheese last year.

(Picture: Cheese on sale at a market in London. Copyright BBC)
